rigourist.translation: n. 作风严肃的人, 要求严格的人

rigours.definition:
n. the quality of being valid and rigorous
n. something hard to endure
n. excessive sternness
rigours.translation: n. 严格( rigour的复数形式 ); 严谨; 严酷; 艰苦

rigout.translation:
n. 〈英俚〉一套服装
[网络] 装配；打扮，装束；为…提供装备

rigs.definition:
n gear (including necessary machinery) for a particular enterprise
n a truck consisting of a tractor and trailer together
n formation of masts, spars, sails, etc., on a vessel
n a set of clothing (with accessories)
n gear used in fishing
n a vehicle with wheels drawn by one or more horses
n the act of swindling by some fraudulent scheme
v arrange the outcome of by means of deceit
v manipulate in a fraudulent manner
v connect or secure to
v equip with sails or masts
rigs.translation:
n. 船桅（或船帆等）的装置( rig的名词复数 ); 成套器械
v. 给（船、桅杆）装配帆及索具( rig的第三人称单数 ); 用临时替代材料迅速搭起; （用不正当手段）操纵; 垄断

rigsdaler.definition:
n. A Danish coin worth about fifty-four cents. It was the
   former unit of value in Denmark.
rigsdaler.translation: n. 从前在荷兰, 德国等使用的银币
